//: Every version in this repo lives in gradle/libs.versions.toml; doctor.py fails on a coordinate written anywhere else, so the version catalog manager is the only one that has anything to do.

packageRules.description: One PR per family rather than per artifact: these move together and are tested together, and 40 separate PRs is how a template's catalog goes stale.
The Kotlin version drives the Compose compiler plugin and the serialization plugin — bumping one without the others does not build.
AGP is the one that breaks the build DSL, so it gets its own PR to review.
A template should start on stable. Pre-release versions are opened only when the catalog already holds one.
